Needs changes before merge.

The four changed lines remove the machine owner's handle. The post logic and the NC machine instructions do not change.

Requested before merge:

1. **Recorded-program declaration** — `docs/evidence/614-dnm5700-sample.nc:3`: Add a `Goldens moved` section to the PR body. List this file and state that only its source comment changes. The review rule requires this declaration for each changed recorded `*.nc` program.
2. **Issue tracking** — PR body, final line; commit `8d29bf092762f16075acac4374319b08b856bbdf`: The change has no tracked issue reference. The body does not end with `Fixes #N`. The commit message also has no issue reference. Link the issue for this request and supply the required closing reference. The existing references to #614 and #616 describe historical work.

Local results:

- Base: upstream/main `034e91b8b78fa64989d18e1d5d17344531c4762c`. This base is already an ancestor of the PR head. The trial merge reported `Already up to date.` HEAD is the PR head; HEAD^1 is the base. There is no trial merge commit.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed all 72 steps. The run passed 528 tests and ignored 4 tests.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: passed all 6 steps, including the release build. All 11 light tests passed.
- Both debug test builds passed. All 46 post suites and 24 app suites passed.
- The full diff and the changed NC sample were read. A comparison confirmed that all content outside the changed comments is byte-identical to main.
- `git diff --check`: passed.
- Clippy: not run. No Rust source or manifest changed.

Extra suites run:

- `example_catalog`: 43 passed, 4 ignored.
- `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed.
- `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
- `script_doosan_dnm`: 11 passed, including the recorded golden comparisons.
- Light suites: motion lib (7 passed); adaptive_troch_island, adaptive_troch_neck, adaptive_troch_parallel, and pocket_pass_start (1 passed each).
- The catalog and Doosan suites ran in the quick gate. No importer or test-data suite applies. No test source in `crates/` or `xtask/` reads the changed evidence file.

Mutations: not applicable. This change does not change posted G-code, geometry, simulation, or gouge and collision checks. No UI files changed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

- Recorded-program declaration: added “Goldens moved” to the PR body. It lists `docs/evidence/614-dnm5700-sample.nc` and states that only the SOURCE comment changed. The metadata pin `recorded_program_declaration` fails with the section removed and passes when restored. NC instructions are byte-identical.
- Issue tracking: filed #4082 for the owner's request. The body ends with `Fixes #4082`. An empty follow-up commit adds the same closing reference without rewriting history or changing files. The metadata pin `issue_tracking` fails when either reference is removed and passes when restored.

New head: `09f8ffcfa5af01a2ecf53fc5358558cb6e8aebe2`.

Final-head quick gate: 72 steps passed; 528 tests passed, 4 ignored. Light gate: 6 steps passed; all 11 tests passed. Catalog: 43 passed, 4 ignored; adaptive and edge-work each passed. Doosan golden suite: 11 passed. Clippy and heavy lanes do not apply to this comment-only diff; the PR body records the limits.

Please re-review. The PR remains draft. The warm worktree is retained.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 09f8ffcfa5af01a2ecf53fc5358558cb6e8aebe2 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

This is a re-review. The earlier review is on head `8d29bf092` and it requested two changes.

## Earlier findings

1. **Recorded-program declaration** - fixed. The body now has a "Goldens moved" section. It lists `docs/evidence/614-dnm5700-sample.nc` and says that only the `(SOURCE: ...)` comment changes. The diff agrees: line 3 is the only changed line of that file.
2. **Issue tracking** - fixed. Issue #4082 tracks the request. The body ends with `Fixes #4082`. The new commit `09f8ffcfa` has the same closing reference.

## The new head

- `09f8ffcfa` is an empty commit. `git diff 8d29bf092 09f8ffcfa` prints nothing, so the tree of the new head is the tree of the reviewed head.
- The full diff against main is 3 files and 4 lines. Each line replaces the GitHub handle with "a machine owner".
- `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps:31` is a `//` comment line in the header block. The edit replaces one line with one line, so no line number of the script moves.
- `docs/evidence/614-dnm5700-sample.nc:3` is a comment of an evidence file. A search of `*.rs`, `*.toml`, `*.json`, `*.sh`, `*.ps1` and `*.yml` finds no reader of `614-dnm5700-sample` or `docs/evidence`.
- `RECOMMENDED.md:22583` and `RECOMMENDED.md:25228` change only the name in two existing entries. The PR adds no decision entry there.
- A case-insensitive search of the full tree finds no other occurrence of the handle.
- The two commit subjects are conventional `docs:` subjects. The body has `Changelog: none`.

## Tier

This is not a SAFETY-tier review. The PR does not change posted G-code, a gouge or collision check, the stock simulation or geometry. A comment has no behaviour to mutate, so no mutation ran. The suites below confirm that the output of the post does not change.

## Results merged with main (built locally)

The PR head already contains `upstream/main` (`034e91b8b`). `git merge upstream/main` reports "Already up to date", so the tested tree is the PR head. GitHub reports `MERGEABLE`.

The suites ran on the tree of `8d29bf092`. That tree is identical to the tree of `09f8ffcfa`.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-post` (all binaries, `doosan_dnm_post` and `declared_options` included) | 142 binaries ok, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-app --test conformance` (recorded `.nc` programs, `doosan-dnm` included) | 7 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-app --test example_catalog` | 43 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored |
| `camcraft-app --test doosan_dnm_a_state` | 2 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test rotary_feed_cap` | 11 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test probe_no_coolant` | 5 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test program_units` | 7 passed |

Extra suites run: none are owed. The diff changes no file under `testdata/` or a golden directory, and it does not touch import code.

Not run in this review:

- `cargo xtask gate quick` did not run here. The compile cache (sccache) on this host did not answer, and the dry-run stopped at its time limit. This is a host problem, not a problem of the PR. The suites above ran with direct `cargo test` calls and without the cache. The earlier review and the author record a green quick gate (72 steps) for this tree.
- Clippy did not run. The diff changes no Rust code.
- The heavy lanes did not run. The diff does not reach them.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Optional, non-blocking

- The links to the comment `issues/614#issuecomment-6764944619` stay in the three files. That page shows the handle of its author. The body says that the links stay. If the owner also wants the links removed, that is a second change.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
